rationale: Preserve exported store and CLI interfaces, command ordering, typed verdicts, exact PR/revision lookup, inbox/gate/frontier formats and atomic replacement. Require an explicit writable store outside the package tree. Reject existing inbox symbolic links before initialization, pointer writes or drain. Source adaptation is reviewed separately from dependency-blocked CLI execution; fresh correction review is pending. Stale locks require ownership review and never recover automatically; explicit force remains a caller decision. Store records are bookkeeping and do not prove host worker existence, completion, method evidence or assignment authorization. CLI execution and full dependency-backed suite remain blocked by missing pinned dependencies. Tests require ORCH_TEST_ROOT in task-owned scratch. Atomic rename protects the last valid record; fsync durability, adversarial path races, crash interruption during rename and host worker recovery are unverified.
